elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting the other party's personnel.
elements.evidence: The first sentence expressly binds both parties, including Customer, from soliciting covered personnel during the Agreement term and for one year after termination.

elements.element: The non-solicitation obligation applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause begins, “Neither party shall,” and applies symmetrically to each party's solicitation of the other party's personnel.

elements.element: The restriction applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The covered class is limited to personnel “who have had direct involvement with the Services.”

elements.element: The post-involvement restricted period is limited to 12 months.
elements.evidence: The restriction lasts throughout the Agreement term and for one year after termination. If an individual's involvement ends before termination, the restriction can continue for more than 12 months after that involvement ends.

elements.element: The restricted period is measured from the end of each covered person's involvement in the Services, rather than from termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The clause measures the restriction through one year after termination of the Agreement and contains no trigger tied to the end of an individual's involvement.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the non-solicitation restriction.
elements.evidence: The added language excludes “placing general advertisements or conducting other recruiting efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel,” including hiring respondents.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from the non-solicitation restriction.
elements.evidence: The added language permits hiring any person who approaches a party on an unsolicited basis.

elements.element: The clause does not prohibit hiring personnel where no prohibited solicitation occurred.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition is limited to “solicit for hire” and does not independently prohibit hiring; the carve-outs also expressly permit hiring respondents to general recruiting and unsolicited applicants.

result.reason: The redline adds the required general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and retains a mutual, directly involved-personnel scope without creating a no-hire. However, it retains the original timing trigger—one year after Agreement termination—rather than 12 months from the end of each person's involvement. It therefore satisfies neither the preferred nor the complete fallback position. The changes do not disturb unrelated commercial terms, but they are incomplete for purposes of reaching an accepted position.
